summary: A SLOOP-based groovebox firmware aimed at forest, psytrance, Goa and hitech, with ready-made grooves, its own drum sounds and four factory songs. Released as a test version.
features: Four 240-bar factory songs with atmosphere, build, drop and break sections
ARP swaps the bass pattern: gallop, offbeat or full-on
PSY FX page: shared filter, space, feedback and drive, ring mod
USB and TRS MIDI: notes and clock; sound CCs not implemented
Full listening and controls test on hardware still pending
